01

The starting question

Useful sector intelligence depends on checked, documented data presented in a way technical teams can use.

02

Contributed to agricultural statistics collection and processing, indicator monitoring and reporting materials.

03

This work strengthened my practice of data quality and turning indicators into monitoring materials. Internal data are not published here.
